title: The Sparkly Blue New Year's Eve Party Outfit
description: A sparkly blue New Year's Eve party outfit from Amazon: a light blue sequin mini dress, a lilac cropped faux fur jacket, a pearl handle satin clutch, pearl ankle strap block heels, gold star earrings and a pearl knotted headband.
intro: I stood in my closet last NYE holding a black dress for the fifth year in a row and said out loud, no. This year I'm going full sparkle. A light blue sequin mini dress, a lilac faux fur jacket I'll wear way past January, a pearl handle clutch that fits my phone and a lip gloss, and block heels with pearl ankle straps because I plan to dance. Gold star earrings and a pearl headband finish it. Black dress, you're benched.

sections.heading: The dress and the jacket
paragraphs: The Bridesmay sparkly long sleeve sequin mini dress in Sequin Light Blue, with the Zando cropped faux fur jacket in Purple (it reads lilac) thrown over it for the walk in.

sections.heading: Shoes, bag and the sparkly bits
paragraphs: PIZZ ANNU pearl ankle strap block heel sandals in White Pearl (a 2 in heel, so you can actually dance), the Beatfull pearl handle satin clutch in White, gold star tassel drop earrings and a light blue pearl and rhinestone knotted headband.
